description: Normalize Harbor/Trivy finding documents at ingest time — stamps ingested_at, and defaults the human-assessment fields to explicit nulls when the sync script didn't already carry forward a prior assessment. Deliberately does NOT drop any severity level (unlike the GVM pipeline's threat=Log filter) — Harbor/Trivy findings don't have an equivalent purely-informational bucket, every row here is a real reported vulnerability.

script.description: Default the human-assessment fields to explicit null only when absent -- equivalent to Elasticsearch's 'set value:null override:false', which OpenSearch's set processor rejects (its schema requires a non-null 'value'; confirmed live via _simulate, see project_opensearch_migration_status memory). Never overwrites a real value a downstream tool already wrote.
script.source: for (field in params.fields) { if (!ctx.containsKey(field)) { ctx.put(field, null); } }
